Messages.Author: Semprini
Messages.Body:
I looked through the book, the marvin FAQ and the official answer
lists and couldn't answer these questions.

1) Jazz Wentworth bleeds me. He then untaps using Freak Drive.
May he do the same action again (bleed me) or must he do another
action. [My guess: it doesn't say he can't, so he can]

2) When a player goes to 0 pool, are they ousted instantaneously,
at the end of the phase, at the end of a turn? Or is it possible to
do something to gain pool? It happened that I lost my last pool
due to a Sabbat Threat counter during untap, but could have gained
one pool from a Blood Doll in the master phase. [My guess: it's
instantaneously.]

Thanks in advance, oh prodigial Primogens...

--

bathe in each and every evening, except for ska...@u.washington.edu
yesterday evening, when I rollerbladed over
to the Masonic temple to play pinochle with I'm not a TV, doctor,
Pope John Paul the First. (King Missile) but I play on one.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ska...@u.washington.edu (Semprini) writes:

>I looked through the book, the marvin FAQ and the official answer
>lists and couldn't answer these questions.

>1) Jazz Wentworth bleeds me. He then untaps using Freak Drive.
>May he do the same action again (bleed me) or must he do another
>action. [My guess: it doesn't say he can't, so he can]

Excellent reasoning (and correct, to boot!).

>2) When a player goes to 0 pool, are they ousted instantaneously,
>at the end of the phase, at the end of a turn? Or is it possible to
>do something to gain pool? It happened that I lost my last pool
>due to a Sabbat Threat counter during untap, but could have gained
>one pool from a Blood Doll in the master phase. [My guess: it's
>instantaneously.]

instantaneous, correct. (cf: ruling on blocking a Aching Beauty (Meth
pays one pool to block this minion) - if blocking costs you your last
pool, you are ousted before combat can take place.)
